Technical Manual

## What this workflow does

The CVD events workflow combines the fixed 2009–2023 history with an authorised cumulative REDCap extract from 2024 onwards. It creates private analytical inputs, calculates hospital-recorded and mortality-linked statistics, applies disclosure control, supports human review and approval, and publishes the approved data package.

::: {.callout-tip title="Workflow at a glance" appearance="simple"}
1. Extract the authorised completed month from REDCap.
2. Combine it with the fixed historical CVD data.
3. Create private de-identified analytical inputs.
4. Calculate hospital-recorded and death-certificate-only (DCO) statistics.
5. Apply disclosure control, review the proposed public data and approve the exact files.
6. Verify and publish only the approved files.
:::

## Workflow and control points

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A["1. Authorised REDCap extract"] --> B["2. Confidential cumulative data"]
    B --> C["3. De-identified analytical inputs"]
    C --> D["4. Calculated private statistics"]
    D --> E["5. Protected, reviewed and approved package"]
    E --> F["6. Published analytical package"]
```

Each box is a separate controlled stage. Each arrow is a controlled move to the next stage. Completion of one stage does not approve or publish the next stage’s files.

Steps 1–5 remain private. Step 6 alone copies the approved analytical files into the official public-data area and the website’s data-file mirror. A successful Step 6 publication does not render or deploy the website; those are separate Quarto and GitHub procedures.

| Step | What the operator does | Main result |
|---|---|---|
| [1. Extract REDCap](extract-redcap.qmd) | Select the authorised completed month and run the secure extract. | Private CSV, Stata copy and extraction record. |
| [2. Prepare confidential data](prepare-confidential.qmd) | Combine the extract with the fixed historical data and review any quarantined source records. | Private cumulative event-level dataset. |
| [3. Create analytical inputs](create-analysis-inputs.qmd) | Create the approved de-identified datasets for each type of analysis. | Private purpose-specific analytical datasets. |
| [4. Generate metrics](generate-metrics.qmd) | Select the event and mortality data releases, run linkage and calculate the statistics. | Private calculated datasets and review evidence. |
| [5. Review and approve](review-approve.qmd) | Prepare the proposed public file, review the evidence and record approval in Stata. | Exact approved seven-file package. |
| [6. Publish metrics](publish-metrics.qmd) | Verify the approval and file checks, then publish the approved package. | Official public analytical copy and website data-file copy. |

## Rules used by the workflow

The procedure pages explain how to run each step. Use the Reference pages when you need the complete implemented rules:

- [CVD death-classification rules](../../reference/cvd-death-classification-rules.qmd) define the mortality groups used by linkage.
- [CVD event–death linkage rules](../../reference/cvd-event-death-linkage-rules.qmd) define person matching, the 0–27-day episode window and aggregate unresolved-DCO estimation.
- [Disclosure-control rules](../../reference/disclosure-control-rules.qmd) define small-number protection and the checks applied before approval.
